title: Lobby / Poster archive collage

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Bring historical work into a service space because an archive can make institutional continuity visible during an everyday visit.
strategic_value: The dense collage of past posters can turn the box-office counter into a record of The Public’s varied cultural output.
demonstration: Poster fragments cover the wall behind a glazed counter and its lower front; lamps, chairs and ceiling lights establish the lobby setting.
practical_value: Compare reuse of archival graphics as environmental material rather than as separate framed artifacts.

content_islands.name: Upper collage
content_islands.spec: Fill the wall behind the counter with cropped poster fragments.

content_islands.name: Counter and lower band
content_islands.spec: Retain the glass, task lights and matching collage below the dark counter to show the installation as used.

reference_purposes.Expression: Cropped historical posters form a dense field of contrasting type, colors and images.
reference_purposes.Application: Historical poster fragments are applied to the box-office wall and lower counter front.
